rows.ja: 株主・決済などの供給元

relations.text: 主要株主(13.8%)で、WeixinやQQなどで事業の様々な面で協業
relations.text_en: A principal shareholder (13.8%) that it works with across its business, including Weixin and QQ

source.label: PDD Holdings 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: We collaborate with Tencent, one of our principal shareholders and the owner of Weixin and QQ, with respect to various aspects of our business.

relations.text: dLocalの決済サービスを使う世界の加盟店の一社としてTemuが挙がる
relations.text_en: dLocal lists Temu among global merchants using its payment services

source.label: dLocal 20-F(2024年度)
source.quote: over 700 global merchants, including brand names such as Shein, Didi, Payoneer, Temu, Google, Facebook, Rappi, Deel, Uber, SpaceX, Worldpay and Spotify

relations.text: Cash App Payが使える加盟店の例としてTemuが挙がる
relations.text_en: Block lists Temu among merchants accepting Cash App Pay

source.label: Block 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Cash App Pay allows customers to seamlessly pay with a Cash App account at participating merchants like DoorDash, Lyft, Google Play Store, Temu, and many more, including thousands of Square sellers.

relations.text: Armlogiが物流の顧客区分としてTemu向けを拡大
relations.text_en: Armlogi expanded its Temu customer segment

source.label: Armlogi 10-K(2026年6月期)
source.quote: The Temu and TikTok customer segments were also expanded between the fiscal year ended June 30, 2025 and the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026.

companies.name: アイパワー
companies.sub: 園芸用品のネット販売

relations.text: iPowerが販売チャネルの一つとしてTemuを使う
relations.text_en: iPower sells through Temu as one of its channels

source.label: iPower 10-K(2025年6月期)
source.quote: Our sales channels currently include Amazon Vendor, Amazon 3P, Walmart.com, Tiktok, Temu, and other marketplaces as well as our e-commerce websites such as simpledeluxe.com and more.

relations.text: 知的財産や不正競争をめぐって互いに提訴し合う競合
relations.text_en: A rival with which it is in cross-lawsuits over IP and unfair competition

source.label: PDD Holdings 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: In December 2023, to protect Temu's intellectual property and defend Temu against further harm from unfair competitive practices, Temu filed a complaint in the United States District Court for the District of Columbia against SHEIN.

relations.text: Jumiaが20-Fで、ナイジェリアの競合としてTemuを挙げる
relations.text_en: Jumia names Temu as a current competitor in Nigeria

source.label: Jumia 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: Current competitors, such as Amazon and Noon in Egypt, and Temu and Konga in Nigeria, may seek to intensify their investments in those markets and also expand their businesses in new markets.

relations.text: Beyondが10-Kで、競合するネット通販の一社としてTemuを挙げる
relations.text_en: Beyond names Temu among competing online retailers

source.label: Beyond 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: online retailers with or without discount departments, including Amazon.com, AliExpress (part of the Alibaba Group), eBay, Temu, and Rakuten.com;

relations.text: Hepsiburadaが20-Fで、トルコの主な競合として新たにTemuを挙げる
relations.text_en: Hepsiburada names Temu among its main Turkish competitors

source.label: Hepsiburada 20-F(2024年度)
source.quote: Hepsiburada's main e-commerce competitors in Türkiye include Trendyol, Amazon, N11 and more recently, Temu.

relations.text: Tilly'sが10-Kで、競合するネット小売の一社としてTemuを挙げる
relations.text_en: Tilly's names Temu among online retailers it competes with

source.label: Tilly's 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: In addition, we compete with independent specialty shops, department stores, off-price retailers, online marketplaces such as Amazon, online retailers such as Shein, Revolve, Temu, and Fashion Nova

relations.text: RedCloudが20-Fで、大手の間接的な競合としてTemuを挙げる
relations.text_en: RedCloud names Temu among large indirect competitors

source.label: RedCloud 20-F(2024年度)
source.quote: Additionally, there are a number of large indirect competitors that specialize in online commerce or derive a substantial portion of their revenues from online commerce, such as, Shein and Temu.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
